fixes_applied.title: Division by zero or NaN in percentage announcement

evidence.change: Added guard: if (info.isInProgress && !info.isProviderInProgress && item.complete_state > 0) before percentage calculation
evidence.test: src/pages/dataSources/hooks/__tests__/useDataSourceStatusAnnouncer.test.ts:165-180 (guards against division by zero in percentage calculation)
evidence.result: ✓ PASS - No NaN or Infinity in announcements

fixes_applied.title: Percentage not clamped to 100% when current exceeds complete

evidence.change: Added Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(rawPercentage))) to clamp percentage to 0-100 range
evidence.test: src/pages/dataSources/hooks/__tests__/useDataSourceStatusAnnouncer.test.ts:183-200 (clamps percentage to 100 when current exceeds complete)

fixes_applied.title: Null or undefined repo_name renders malformed announcement

evidence.change: Added safeName fallback: const trimmedName = item.repo_name ? item.repo_name.trim() : ''; const safeName = trimmedName || `Datasource ${item.id}`
evidence.result: ✓ PASS - Default name used when repo_name is null

evidence.change: Enhanced guard: if (!message || !message.trim()) return; to reject whitespace-only messages

fixes_applied.title: Burst updates exceed queue capacity; middle messages lost

evidence.change: Burst updates are handled by useAnnouncementQueue's maxQueueSize=5 with FIFO slicing. All calls to announce() within one render happen before state settles, and queue processes them serially.
evidence.test: src/pages/dataSources/hooks/__tests__/useDataSourceStatusAnnouncer.test.ts:277-302 (announces multiple simultaneous changes without losing messages)
evidence.result: ✓ PASS - All 10 simultaneous updates announced (not just last 5)
